description: Queue a post with the founder's own picture and caption for the product's connected Instagram or X account. Nothing is written or drawn by Hustlin: the image at imageUrl and the caption go out as given, with only the tracked link handled as usual ("Link in bio." added on Instagram, the short link on its own last line on X when it fits). The post waits in the approval queue and is never published without the founder's approve, whatever the product's mode; show the founder the image and caption from actions, then call approve when they say yes. Approved with a scheduledFor still ahead it posts at that time, otherwise at once. Approver or higher.

caption.description: The caption, published exactly as written. Instagram: up to 2200 characters and 30 hashtags; links are not clickable there. X: up to 280 characters as X counts them (a link counts 23, an emoji 2).

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the picture to post (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB), e.g. https://pojus.com/d/<dishId>/card. Instagram needs a shape between 4:5 and 1.91:1.

scheduledFor.description: ISO-8601 date and time to post it. Optional. Once approved, the post goes out at the first 15-minute run at or after this time; with no time, or one already past, approving publishes at once.

name: queue_post
title: Queue your own post
